summary: Co-Diagnostics, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $7.9 million of common stock through Maxim Group as sales agent. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under a Form S-3 registration statement, with a fixed 3% commission. No special-situation elements such as acquisitions, spin-offs, or activist campaigns are present. The offer price is based on market, with no premium or fixed price per share. The registrant acts solely as issuer selling its own shares, not as an acquirer or target. This is a standard capital-raising mechanism, not a special situation, so the appropriate classification is 'None'.
